note: Round 8 (Larus GL-2) exploration and diagnosis. Not gate files. Probes in out/sweep/round8 and the physics agent's scratch probes; every number below was measured by the file or log named with it.

rows.tag: keyway gear side (item 1; SPEC crushing ruling after round 7)
rows.found: JIS G4051:2016 and G4053:2016 specify no mechanical properties (kikakurui.com text: values not specified); the old JIS-style tables survive as reference values (Furuike stockist sheet). KHK states only 'gear teeth induction hardened' for the SSAG1-40 (core treatment not stated) and 'carburized' for MSGA/MSGB.
rows.basis: S45C: lowest condition with a value (N, yield 345, reference) at half. SCM415: tensile 830 only (reference): half for tensile-only and half again for a reference value. Alternatives disclosed in the catalogue: 245 (S45C H row / 2) and 415 (SCM415 830 / 2).
rows.6061_T6_2mm_sheet: EN 485-2 T6 row confirmed (Rm >= 290, Rp0.2 >= 240 MPa, 1.5-3 mm; Metallservice and Alumeco tables): 240 MPa kept
rows.effect: every gear-side keyway still rated with FoS >= 1.5 on v18 (out/sweep/round8 members probe)

options: KHK DSF F-Loc (reference slipping torque 2.22 N m at 8 mm bore, 0.62 at 5 mm; KHK calls its values reference only): at half, 1.11 / 0.31 N m; the shaft-3 fixing would reach FoS 1.11 / 0.79 = 1.41 < 1.5, the 5 mm bores far less; no DSF1-18 or DSF1-64 in the 2025 catalogue
KHK keyed J-series: smallest J bore 8 mm (SSA1-xxJ8, 20-48 teeth, 3 x 1.4 keyway); SUS1 J8 and PS J6/J8 are set-screw only; SS module 1 has no J series; no 5 mm keyed bore for the motor pinion
steel keyed replacements for the two DS stages (MSGA1-18 + MSGA1-40 class): about +100 g; SSA1-48J8 140 g with 2.13 N m surface (below 2.8)

other makers: HPC keyless hubs (SUP-005 10.1 N m) need a 14 mm gear bore an 18-20 tooth pinion cannot take; Ruland MCLC-8-8-F 50 N m 'for guidance only', 102 g; no 5 mm Ruland figure read; SDP/SI Fairloc publishes no torque
rows.verdict: no eligible light rated fixing: the four DS fixings stay unrated (M7 FAIL)

rows.design: src/design/airframe.js; d.structure.airframe (positions, plate areas, clearances_mm, fastener and tie counts)
rows.parts: 7075-T6 shoulder rails 12/10 mm on both plates with 6061-T6 brackets (bonded sleeves, Araldite 2011 Al) and screwed torsion locks; plates 1.6 mm aft / 1.2 mm forward (solid outlines); three 6061-T6 box panels bonded; Rock West T-RND-393 keel / boom in two bonded clamps on the plates; forward tray (bent channel) and aft tray screwed to the plates with doublers; motor on two M3 in its threads; cable ties for battery, ESC, receiver, pitot, servos, FC, GPS, encoder, pod formers and tail
rows.ratings: ISO 4762 M3 class 10.9: ISO 898-1 proof load 4180 N (Optimas), shear proof / sqrt 3; HellermannTyton T18R 80 N minimum loop; Araldite 2011 13.0 MPa on aluminium and 9.55 MPa on CFRP (typical, half); Rock West CLT transverse 133 and XY shear 48.2 MPa (half)
rows.new_load_channels: sf_origin, wdot, w2 (inertial bound m (|f_o| + r |wdot| + r |w|^2)), tail_F
rows.packing: the frame is not in the film's packing check; computed clearances to every gear tip circle and rocker hub are >= 0 but as small as 0.1-0.7 mm (side panels to the DS1-64, rails to the rocker hubs); the boom over the gearbox is 7 mm above the current pod outline; the spar sockets' sweep past the rails is not checked
rows.result_v18: every airframe member FoS >= 1.50 on the M7 population probe (out/sweep/round8 members probe on v18)

rows.baseline_v17_eta0.6: 97/100 nominal; corners 97-99 (seeds 15, 27 on altitude, 79 on pitch)
rows.found: at Vrough 15 m/s the stroke sits at its envelope (2.72 Hz) for most of the run, and the balanced TECS pitch split the energy shortfall between height and speed
rows.change: TECS speed weight 0.5 above the floor band (control.js tecsWeights, as ArduPlane's TECS_SPDWEIGHT): pitch holds height and lets speed fall to the band before height
rows.v17_eta0.45_spdWeight0.5: 98 / 98 / 98 (nominal, aero0.9 mass1.05 cg+5, aero1.1 mass1.05 cg+5)
rows.drive_headroom: MSGA1-20 + MSGB1-45 crank stage (KHK pages read; train rating 14.16 -> 15.36 N m, limited then by DS1-20): +35 g; on the AR 6 airframe it keeps the crank torque within its rating but M4 drops to 96/100 at aero0.9 mass1.05 (v18g); not adopted

rows.launch_climb: the hand-launch climb command from 1 to 3 m/s (control.launchClimb_m_s): v17 worst corner 1.537 -> 1.095 m over 0-10 deg releases at 8 m/s
rows.airframe_effect: AR 7 with the airframe: 2.28 m (v18a), 2.20 m (v18b); AR 6.5: 1.61 m; AR 6: 0.93-1.19 m
rows.v18: 8 m/s: worst corner 1.03 m at 5 deg (the gate's case), 1.07 at 0 deg, 1.13 at 10 deg (margin 0.37-0.47 m); 7 m/s release (outside the gate's case, information): 2.52 m, fails

rows.what: aspect ratio 7 -> 6 at 2.0 m span (S 0.571 -> 0.667 m2); the calibration was refitted on the new wing by V5
rows.v5: PASS, worst held-out lift 1.4%, thrust 2.6% (out/sweep/round8/v5-v18h.log; data/calibration/larus-gl-2.json)
rows.cost: crank torque peak about 14.9 N m on the M7 population against the 14.16 N m train rating (MSGA1-18 surface durability at stage 4)

rows.rule: >= 98 of 100 seeds at nominal and at each of the 8 robustness corners; eta_s constant on every strip; design flown as built at 0.6
rows.target: 0.45 not reached; the hard seeds (15, 27) are energy-limited with the stroke at its motor-speed envelope
